title: Yummy Herbal Chinese Penne Jiaozi
description: A velvety, herbal hangover cure that blends low‑carb penne rigate with a savory jiaozi filling, finished al dente for a comforting lunch.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add sesame oil.
Sauté minced garlic and ginger until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add ground pork, breaking it apart, and cook until browned, about 4 minutes.
Stir in shredded cabbage and scallion, cooking until the cabbage wilts, about 2 minutes.
Season the mixture with soy sauce and crushed ginseng root, stirring well.
Set the filling aside to cool slightly, then toss it with the cooked low-carb penne rigate.
Lay a jiaozi wrapper flat and place a heaping spoonful of the penne‑pork mixture in the center.
Fold the wrapper into a half‑moon shape, sealing the edges with a pinch of water.
Arrange the formed jiaozi on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes or until golden.
Serve the warm, herbal jiaozi with a drizzle of soy sauce and a sprinkle of fresh scallion.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
